versions._note: DRAFT, for Julia (TUT-14): Key's extra versions of each step, rung and mistake line. The first version is the library's (or the pack's) own; these follow it in turn, never the same one twice in a row. All unapproved (CON-04, CON-09); height words only, a weight story keeps its one mass line.
cmp.drawA: Put a bar here for the {a}.
Start with the {a}. Drag a bar up.
cmp.placeB: Now the {b}. Drag its bar here.
cmp.sizeB: Make the {b} bar the right size.
Size the {b} bar. The story tells you how.
cmp.placeGap: Where does the gap go? Drag it there.
Now put the gap on your bars.
cmp.placeTotal: Where does the total go? Drag it there.
Now put the total on your drawing.
cmp.chooseOp: Pick the sum that finds the {b}.
Look at your bars. Which sum finds the {b}?
cmp.findB: Work it out. How tall is the {b}?
Now find the height of the {b}.
cmp.findTotal: Both together: how tall are they?
cmp.totalWrong: The total is both bars together.
Where do both bars end? The total covers them.
cmp.opposite: Check your bars. Is the {b} bar longer or shorter?
Look back at the drawing. Is the {b} longer or shorter?
cmp.tryAgain: Not yet. Work that sum once more.
Let's look at that sum one more time.
cmp.addBoth: Not yet. Put both bars together.
Not yet. Both bars together make the total.
cmp.regrouping: Let's look at the ones together.
The ones need a closer look. Let's see.
cmp.carry: Let's look at the ones as we add.
cmp.sideBack: That trick helps. Back to your case!
Now back to the case, where you were.
line.hint.height-of-a: Look at the story. What height is the {a}?
line.nudge.reach-A: So close. The {a} bar needs to reach {A} {unit}.
line.hint.now-b: Now the {b}. What do we know about its height?
Next, the {b}. What does the story say about it?
line.hint.taller-or-shorter: Read it again. Is the {b} taller or shorter?
Which is taller, the {a} or the {b}?
line.hint.which-is-it: Who is 'it' in the story: the {a} or the {b}?
Read the second sentence. Is 'it' the {a} or the {b}?
line.hint.look-at-colours: Words in the same colour go together. Which one is 'it'?
Find 'it' in colour. Which words have the same colour?
line.hint.D-tall-or-relation: Is {D} {unit} the height of the {b}, or the gap between the bars?
Does {D} {unit} tell us how tall the {b} is, or how much {b_word} it is?
line.hint.grown-up-and-you: Stand next to a grown-up. Who is taller?
Picture you and a grown-up side by side. Who is taller?
line.hint.longer-or-shorter-bar: Look at your bars. Would a taller {kind} have a longer bar or a shorter bar?
Which bar is longer? Is that the one you need to find?
line.hint.which-taller: Which {kind} is taller? Read the story again.
Does the story tell us which {kind} is taller?
line.hint.two-bars: Let's draw a bar for each one.
One bar for the {a}, one for the {b}.
line.check.again: Look at your sum once more.
Go over your sum one more time.
